# Optional task / session handoff

Use the fields useful to the work; a short message is sufficient for a small task.
Current workflow guidance: [AGENTS](../../AGENTS.md).

- Outcome and current user direction:
- Relevant sources and existing implementation:
- Changes, working directory/revision and unfinished ownership:
- Verification performed, results, environment and limits:
- Outstanding work, decisions and already-granted authorizations:
- Suggested continuation:

For delegated work, clarify responsibility and how changes will be integrated.
Choose collaboration and isolation based on actual overlap; this template imposes
no model-tier, agent-depth, retry, read-only or mandatory pre-handoff commit rule.
Share relevant context without secrets. Distinguish review performed by the author
from an actual independent review.
